## Familiar with basic linear algebra? You're ready to go. {#prerequisites}

:::: {.prerequisite-list}
::: {.prerequisite-step}
### Step 1: Core Concepts [Required]{.step-badge}

Review vectors, matrices, and SVD in [Goodfellow Ch. 2](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/contents/linear_algebra.html) or complete the [pre-work notebooks]({{< var workshop.prereq_repo_url >}}).
:::

::: {.prerequisite-step}
### Step 2: Setup [Required, 5 mins]{.step-badge}

Run [Notebook 00]({{< var repo.colab_base >}}/00-setup-and-data.ipynb) in Google Colab to pre-load datasets.
:::

::: {.prerequisite-step}
### Step 3: Visual Refresher [Optional]{.step-badge .step-optional}

Watch 3Blue1Brown's [*Essence of linear algebra*]({{< var workshop.prereq_video_url >}}).
:::
